positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and developed bots with the Azure Bot Framework Composer for multiple gaming studios.
Extended the tech stack to include Azure Cosmos DB and Azure Logic Apps in bot functionality.
Daily break-fix work in addressing bugs and edge cases for preexisting code. 
Mapped out and wrote the main source of documentation the PowerShell bot framework, 
Maintained and updated PowerShell based bots, Created and maintained Turn 10s inventory system using WPF. 
Updated permission records and referenced bug logs using Microsoft SQL Server. 
Daily SCRUM sessions.
positions.insights: Skills: Azure Logic Apps · C# · Microsoft Bot Framework · Azure DevOps · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Implementation Consultant
positions.description:
Wrote new code and regularly debugged existing proprietary code to exactly address client’s needs. Collaborated with my team to devise the most efficient software solutions on a daily basis. Implemented solutions involving algorithms, database integrity, and user interfaces. Created testing scenarios and coordinated with the test team to scrutinize solutions that were vital to ensuring a smooth production roll out. I maintained a constant line of communication with the client to make sure their exact needs were understood. Experienced with quickly adapting to working with proprietary software packages. 

Languages and Software:
•	C#, Java, JavaScript, SQL, XML, PHP, HTML, CSS
•	Amazon Web Services (RDS, EC2)
•	SQL Server Management Studio
•	MySQL
•	Microsoft Visual Studios,
•	Eclipse 
•	Github
•	jQuery (Library)

Industry Knowledge:
•	SCRUM
•	Web Development
•	Research and Data Analysis
•	REST API

projects.title: Proto 2-D Fighter
projects.description:
I am currently solo developing a 2D Movement heavy brawler using the Unity engine.
I have been working on it in my free while I work. I currently finishing up on the second out of four characters. I am writing C# scripts within the Unity engine.

projects.title: Dehumidifier - Steam Backlog Check List
projects.description:
I am currently developing a web app which allows users to create a savable, checklist of games in their Steam library to better facilitate working through their backlog.

Features:
-Filter through your library using Steams Tags and game Details
-Suggest a random game to play from your backlog
-Export Checklist to an Excel Document

Languages Used:
-PHP
-SQL
-HTML
-CSS
-JS
-jQuery (Library)

Software / Services Used:
-Amazon Web Services
►EC2
►RDS
-Steam's REST APIs
-MySQL
-Ubuntu
-Apache2
-XAMPP
-FileZilla
-Sublime Text
-Github
-Microsoft Excel
